hypotheses.justification: The domain ℝ × JetPrototype.Phase is inhabited (JetPrototype.Phase is a product of the inhabited position and velocity spaces). Choose any u; hg u gives 0 ≤ |g u| ≤ S, hence 0 ≤ S without hS. The proof can derive hS this way and apply the existing continuity argument.
Choose any u in the inhabited domain ℝ × JetPrototype.Phase. hfB u gives 0 ≤ |f u| ≤ R, hence 0 ≤ R without hR. The proof can derive hR this way and apply the existing continuity argument.
